title: A SCORE CHIP SHOWS ONCE IN THE FEED
why: A goal met, a bounty claimed or a stronghold cleared pays a chip: an alert says what it was with the figure (GOAL DONE  AIR STRIKE  +$300), which is a line in the feed, and a gold +$300 rises over the player. The feed also turns a bare +$ popup into a money line of its own, so every chip showed in the feed twice, the second time on its own, as if it had been paid twice (it was paid once). The style medals already keep their popup out of the feed for exactly this reason. Proven in headless Chromium on real frames: a bounty claim left BOUNTY CLAIMED  BOUNTY PILLAGER  +$1,500 and then a separate +$1,500 line; a goal left GOAL DONE  AIR STRIKE  +$300 and then +$300. The popup over the player stays; the feed keeps the one line.
now: A goal, bounty or stronghold chip now shows once in the feed instead of twice.
